$comment: Allowlist for the release ZIP audit (scripts/audit-zip.mjs). Mirrors docs/architecture.md section 3 and wxt.config.ts. Change docs first, then wxt.config.ts, then this file, and update the privacy policy. Permission order is ignored; any addition or removal fails. Manifest top-level keys outside allowedManifestKeys fail. Risky keys (web_accessible_resources, externally_connectable, sandbox, oauth2, key, update_url, chrome_url_overrides) fail unless a matching expected value is added to this file; web_accessible_resources must also set use_dynamic_url: true on every entry. commands, minimum_chrome_version and content_security_policy must equal the values here.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'self'; media-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; form-action 'none'; base-uri 'none'
